main_measure.name: mean short-signed 5-bar unusual move after short signals (before costs)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 over at least 20 cases; reject if t <= -2 over at least 20 cases

supporting_check.name: Spearman correlation of thinness with short-signed unusual move > 0

decided_by: The t of the mean short-signed unusual move lies between -2 and 2 over at least 20 cases.
reading: A short signal is a fall of the forecast of at least 2 points from its level nearest zero on the short side since the last bet (from 0 after flat), the first one per 5-bar grid cell counted from each window's first row, with the coin's drift the mean of its non-overlapping 5-bar grid returns pooled over all windows.
